item.title: contributingChanges
item.description: Contributing Changes https://nginx.org/en/docs/contributing_changes.html Getting Sources Mercurial is used to store source code. The repository can be cloned with the following command: hg clone http://hg.nginx.org/nginx Formatting Changes Changes should be formatted according to the code style used by nginx. Sometimes, there is no clear rule; in such cases examine how existing nginx sources are formatted and mimic this style. Changes will more likely be accepted if style corresponds to the surrounding
